WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', delivered_to_customer_at)::date AS month_start,
        COUNT(*)::integer AS delivered_orders
    FROM olist.orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND delivered_to_customer_at >= TIMESTAMP '2016-11-01 00:00:00'
      AND delivered_to_customer_at <  TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY 1
),
with_moving_average AS (
    SELECT
        month_start,
        delivered_orders,
        ROUND(
            AVG(delivered_orders) OVER (
                ORDER BY month_start
                ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ),
            2
        ) AS moving_average_3_months
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT
    month_start AS month,
    'Pedidos entregues'::text AS series,
    delivered_orders::numeric AS value,
    1 AS series_order
FROM with_moving_average
WHERE month_start >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND month_start <  DATE '2019-01-01'
UNION ALL
SELECT
    month_start AS month,
    'Média móvel (3 meses)'::text AS series,
    moving_average_3_months::numeric AS value,
    2 AS series_order
FROM with_moving_average
WHERE month_start >= DATE '2017-01-01'
  AND month_start <  DATE '2019-01-01'
ORDER BY month, series_order
